convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load external 'BlauHLM' indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic

indicators.name: BlauHLM
indicators.derived_period: min_rates_total = XLength + GetStartBars(XLength1) + GetStartBars(XLength2) + GetStartBars(XLength3) + GetStartBars(XLength4) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
derived_values.formula: XLength + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength1,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength2,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength3,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength4,XPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Signal-based close: BuyPosClose/SellPosClose triggered by opposite signal in breakdown and cloudtwist modes; in twist mode, close is always triggered on signal reversal regardless of BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means MM is fixed lot size; other MarginMode values treat MM as fraction of deposit/margin

custom_logic_notes: EA has 3 operating modes (AlgMode enum): 'breakdown' - trades on histogram crossing zero; 'twist' - trades on histogram direction change (twist of smoothed line); 'cloudtwist' - trades on up/down cloud crossover. Signal is read from bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous completed bar). BUY_Open/SELL_Open gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen inputs. BUY_Close/SELL_Close gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose inputs except in twist mode where close always triggers. Recount flag causes re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Three distinct signal modes must be implemented separately. The BlauHLM custom indicator logic must be ported from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - requires implementing the full multi-stage smoothing chain (XMA with configurable method, 4 nested smoothing lengths). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose and GlobalVariableDel_ - these must be reimplemented with proper position checking, lot sizing from MM/MMMode, and SL/TP application. The SignalBar parameter shifts signal reading back by N bars, critical for avoiding repainting. No digit adjustment needed for SL/TP as they are in points already.
